release_status: Release Candidate 1 (RC1) — NOT merged to main. Awaiting review before promotion to Stable, per explicit instruction.
scope: Medical Regulatory Bodies & Health Missions, Medical Colleges, Government Hospitals, and Government Health Insurance Schemes for Telangana & Andhra Pradesh plus genuinely national-level entities (architected to extend to all 40 briefed healthcare domains and all Indian states without schema change)

datasets_blocked.name: Primary Health Centres (PHC)
datasets_blocked.reason: Telangana and Andhra Pradesh each run several hundred PHCs; per-facility verification exceeds what search-snippet research can do at any meaningful field depth
datasets_blocked.unblock_requires: Bulk structured data export (e.g. HMIS/NHM facility registry) rather than per-institution web research

datasets_blocked.name: Urban Health Centres
datasets_blocked.unblock_requires: State urban health mission bulk facility list

environment_constraint: Direct WebFetch to .gov.in/.ac.in/.edu.in/Wikipedia domains was blocked by this session's organizational egress policy (confirmed HTTP 403 policy denial, re-tested live before collection began). All data collected via WebSearch result snippets only; confidence scores capped at 88. See docs/METHODOLOGY.md.
dependencies: No hard foreign-key dependency on Package001_Geography — state/district fields are free-text values, not district_id references. medical_colleges_telangana_andhra_pradesh.attached_teaching_hospital and government_hospitals_telangana_andhra_pradesh.medical_college_affiliation are free-text cross-references to each other within this package, not enforced FKs. No relationship to Package002_Education in this release.

source_tiers_used: Tier 4 (Trusted news, for time-sensitive scheme-rename and regulatory-transition verification)
source_tiers_not_used: Tier 2 (Official social media — not needed this release)
Tier 5 (Community sources — excluded per package policy for factual data)

confidence_statistics.note: Capped at 88 (no row claims a 90+ 'direct official fetch' score) due to this session's WebFetch restriction — see docs/METHODOLOGY.md confidence_calibration section

known_gaps: Field depth is reduced from the ~30 fields per entity named in the package brief to a smaller verifiable core per entity type — Latitude/Longitude, Google Maps Link, Email, Departments, Specialties, Available Services, ICU Availability, Dialysis, Ambulance Availability, Insurance Accepted, and Working Hours are NOT populated in this release. See docs/METHODOLOGY.md.
Latitude/longitude is 0% populated across every dataset in this release (same known gap as Package001_Geography and Package002_Education)

TVVP (Telangana) and APVVP (Andhra Pradesh) each publish master hospital-list pages, but their tabular contents did not surface in WebSearch snippets — only aggregate counts were found (~175 TVVP, ~228 APVVP). This dataset's 49 rows are a verified subset, not the full state rosters.
~17-19 of Telangana's newer (2022-2023) government medical colleges and several AP colleges were excluded rather than guessed
bed_capacity and contact_number are PENDING_VERIFICATION for many government hospital rows (130 of 1,029 fields in that dataset)
mbbs_seats is PENDING_VERIFICATION for most medical college rows
36 of 40 briefed healthcare domains not researched in this release (BLOCKED/QUEUED, not guessed)
Coverage limited to Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, and national-level entities — remaining states/UTs QUEUED
No row has been promoted to VST-VERIFIED; that is a separate governance action
